test_vectors.execution: Not executed. The task prohibits build, check, compiler, formatter, and test commands.
coverage: Empty input with zero resource limits always produces SWAR.
Raw UTF-8 sorting, exact concatenated spans, zero-padded little-endian heads, dense required bits, and target preservation.
Inclusive SWAR threshold; names a and b produce seed 0 with local slots [0, 1, EMPTY_KEY_SLOT, EMPTY_KEY_SLOT].
Names aa and d collide at seed 0 and succeed at seed 1 with local slots [1, EMPTY_KEY_SLOT, 0, EMPTY_KEY_SLOT].
Zero and exhausted hash-attempt budgets fall back to SWAR; names a and e remain colliding throughout the bounded search.
Input rotations and reversal preserve deterministic entries, bytes, strategy, and required counts.
Duplicate names and FieldIds return ConstraintViolation with field context; FieldIds above 65535 return UnsupportedSchemaFeature.
Inclusive key and key-payload size limits, including selected PHF slot storage; discarded fallback slots do not consume encoded size.
Checked capacity rounding, u32 arithmetic overflow, count conversion, and impossible reservation failures return BudgetExhausted.
65535 required fields succeed; a 65536th required field fails; all 65536 FieldIds are accepted when the final property is optional.
Rebased global key indices and byte spans work for SWAR and PHF; slots pointing into another table fail.
Out-of-bounds and overflowing table ranges, malformed spans, invalid UTF-8, duplicate or unsorted names, wrong heads, duplicate fields, and non-dense required bits fail before a lookup hit or miss.
Invalid PHF capacities, missing or duplicate entries, out-of-range indices, incorrect seed placement, and changed seeds return SchemaImageInvalid.
Structurally valid noncanonical PHF capacity is accepted locally; canonical strategy reproduction belongs to full image validation.
Unknown keys sharing a stored key's hash slot, byte length, and first eight bytes still require exact complete-byte equality.
Composed and decomposed Unicode names remain distinct; emoji names work; truncated UTF-8 scalar spans fail.
A single empty name supports PHF; empty and embedded-NUL names remain distinct despite identical SWAR heads.
A deterministic 96-name corpus is compared with a linear exact-name oracle over 128 present and absent queries.

integration_notes: Construction uses fallible allocation, checked arithmetic, deterministic sorting, and bounded seed search. No unsafe code or additional dependencies are used.
Validation and lookup allocate no heap memory. Field uniqueness uses an 8192-byte fixed bitmap.
Lookup validates the entire unwitnessed table before searching, so its total cost includes linear validation even for PHF.
Build output has local indices and spans. Existing lowering remains responsible for rebasing and global limits.
Header consistency, cross-table ownership, target-state bounds, complete encoded size, and reproduction under compiler options remain the full image validator's responsibility.
